canonical_source.resolved_control: public AI WordPress Manager brand self-navigation anchor
canonical_source.behavior: The public AI WordPress Manager brand returns to the canonical anonymous welcome route.

laravel_adaptation.adaptation_reason: A dedicated web-only public route and identity-neutral view preserve the canonical anonymous brand self-navigation without resolving tenant or user authority.

tenant_isolation.proof: Anonymous and authenticated callers receive the same identity-neutral welcome content, authenticated user sentinels are absent, and /tenants/{tenant}/welcome is not registered.
tenant_isolation.caller_override_probe: The route has no route parameters and the visible control cannot select or interpolate a tenant identity.

semantics.external_dependency: none for this public brand-navigation operation

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and source metadata
absence of auth and tenant.context middleware
exact operation marker and /welcome brand href
anonymous and authenticated response identity neutrality
authenticated user name and email non-disclosure

terminality.basis: The canonical public brand self-navigation is implemented as a real Laravel /welcome control on an anonymous web-only route with operation-linked production/test evidence and deterministic identity non-disclosure proof.
